data.name: Hacienda Pena Pobre, an SLH Hotel
data.address: Cam. a Sta. Teresa 480-2, El Bosque, Tlalpan, 14266 Ciudad de México, CDMX, Mexico
data.description:
Set in a 17th-century hacienda and former paper factory, this refined hotel is an 11-minute walk from MB Corregidora train station, 3 km from Museo Universitario Arte Contemporáneo and 1 km from Bosque de Tlalpan, a forested urban park with hiking and biking trails.
Understated rooms come with flat-screen TVs, free Wi-Fi and designer toiletries. Suites add living/dining rooms and kitchens; upgraded bi-level suites feature 2 bedrooms.
Complimentary perks include pastries, tea and coffee, and continental breakfast served on a leafy rooftop terrace. Other amenities consist of a 24-hour gym, massage services and guest laundry facilities.
